executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from decimal import Decimal
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json,hashlib,re,pandas as pd
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_cash_revision_cause_score_v1'
parent=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name,obj):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));freeze=json.loads((out/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert not (out/'source_gate.json').exists() and sha(out/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256']
for rel,h in freeze['input_hashes'].items():assert sha(root/rel)==h
receipts=json.loads((parent/'release_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['receipts']
metadata={x['quarter']:x for x in json.loads((parent/'actual_release_metadata.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
oldfields={x['quarter']:x for x in json.loads((parent/'原公告字段及原因记录.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
raw={};excerpts=[];hashes={}
for r in receipts:
    p=root/r['path'];assert sha(p)==r['sha256']
    full=' '.join(BeautifulSoup(p.read_bytes(),'html.parser').get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
    begin=full.index('WASHINGTON');end=full.index('Additional financing details',begin)
    found=re.findall(r'[A-Z][a-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4}',full[:begin]);assert found[-1]==metadata[r['quarter']]['body_date_text']
    body=re.sub(r'\s*[\u2013\u2014-]\s*',' - ',full[begin:end])
    raw[r['quarter']]={'receipt':r,'parts':[x.strip() for x in re.split(r'(?=During the\b)',body) if x.startswith('During the')]}
    hashes[r['path']]=r['sha256']
    excerpts.append({'quarter':r['quarter'],'actual_body_date':found[-1],'source_url':r['url'],'body':body})
assert len(raw)==17
months={1:('January','March'),2:('April','June'),3:('July','September'),4:('October','December')}
def prev(q):
    y=int(q[:4]);k=int(q[-1]);return f'{y}Q{k-1}' if k>1 else f'{y-1}Q4'
def part(r,q,actual=False):
    y=int(q[:4]);k=int(q[-1]);m1,m2=months[k];prefix=f'During the {m1} - {m2} {y} quarter'
    hits=[s for s in raw[r]['parts'] if s.startswith(prefix) and ('Treasury borrowed' in s if actual else 'Treasury expects to' in s)]
    assert len(hits)==1,(r,q,actual);return hits[0]
def amount(s,pattern):
    m=re.search(pattern,s);assert m,(pattern,s)
    n=Decimal(m.group(1).replace(',',''))*(Decimal(1000) if len(m.groups())>1 and m.group(2)=='trillion' else Decimal(1))
    assert n==n.to_integral_value();return int(n)
def expected(s):
    borrowing=-amount(s,r'expects to pay down \$([\d,.]+)\s+(billion|trillion)') if 'expects to pay down' in s else amount(s,r'expects to borrow \$([\d,.]+)\s+(billion|trillion)')
    return borrowing,amount(s,r'cash balance of \$([\d,.]+)\s+(billion|trillion)')
rows=[]
for q in protocol['source_scope']['fixed_current_quarters']:
    old=prev(q);prior=part(old,q);current=part(q,q)
    b0,e0=expected(prior);b1,e1=expected(current)
    _,s0=expected(part(old,old));s1=amount(part(q,old,True),r'cash balance of \$([\d,.]+)\s+(billion|trillion)')
    m=re.search(r'borrowing estimate is \$([\d,.]+) billion (higher|lower)',current);assert m,q
    revision=int(Decimal(m.group(1).replace(',','')))*(1 if m.group(2)=='higher' else -1)
    cash=s0-s1+e1-e0;remainder=revision-cash
    datestring=metadata[q]['body_date_text'];usdate=datetime.strptime(datestring,'%B %d, %Y')
    available=pd.Timestamp(usdate.replace(hour=23,minute=59,second=59,tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York')).astimezone(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')))
    prior_date=datetime.strptime(metadata[old]['body_date_text'],'%B %d, %Y').date()
    assert prior_date<usdate.date()
    record={'quarter':q,'actual_publication_date':usdate.date().isoformat(),'available_at':available,
        'prior_actual_publication_date':prior_date.isoformat(),'source_url':raw[q]['receipt']['url'],'source_path':raw[q]['receipt']['path'],'source_sha256':raw[q]['receipt']['sha256'],
        'prior_source_url':raw[old]['receipt']['url'],'prior_source_path':raw[old]['receipt']['path'],'prior_source_sha256':raw[old]['receipt']['sha256'],
        'prior_borrowing':b0,'current_borrowing':b1,'reported_borrowing_revision':revision,'displayed_pair_borrowing_revision':b1-b0,
        'reported_minus_displayed_pair':revision-(b1-b0),'prior_start_cash_assumption':s0,'current_actual_start_cash':s1,
        'prior_end_cash_target':e0,'current_end_cash_target':e1,'start_cash_contribution':s0-s1,'end_cash_target_contribution':e1-e0,
        '美国借款修订现金贡献':cash,'美国扣现金后借款修订':remainder,'source_status':'DIRECT_ORIGINAL_BODY_FIELDS_COMPLETE'}
    check=oldfields[q]
    for key,oldkey in [('prior_borrowing','prior_private_borrowing_billion_usd'),('current_borrowing','current_private_borrowing_billion_usd'),
        ('reported_borrowing_revision','reported_borrowing_revision_billion_usd'),('美国借款修订现金贡献','cash_contribution_total'),
        ('美国扣现金后借款修订','cash_adjusted_borrowing_revision_not_financing_need')]:
        assert record[key]==check[oldkey],(q,key)
    rows.append(record)
data=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('available_at').reset_index(drop=True)
assert len(data)==16 and data.quarter.nunique()==16 and data[protocol['fields']].notna().all().all()
assert (data['美国借款修订现金贡献']+data['美国扣现金后借款修订']==data.reported_borrowing_revision).all()
data.to_parquet(out/'季度借款两渠道状态.parquet',index=False)
data.to_csv(out/'16季度借款两渠道状态.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
save('17原公告直接正文范围.json',excerpts)
gate={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'evaluated_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
    'status':'SOURCE_QUALIFIED_TWO_OBSERVABLE_CHANNELS_BODY_DAY_PROXY_ONLY','all_16_sources_present':True,
    'all_direct_body_fields_present':True,'all_body_dates_and_prior_current_quarters_aligned':True,
    'all_16_source_gate_passed':True,'source_quarter_roots':16,'source_objects_reused':17,'new_downloads':0,
    'source_hashes':hashes,'quarter_field_hash':sha(out/'季度借款两渠道状态.parquet'),
    'source_gate_uses_only_direct_original_bodies':True,'E11_missing_fields_backfilled':False,'E11_original_gate_changed':False,
    'display_precision_unrounded_identity_certified':False,'historic_first_vintage_verified':False,'actual_historic_receipt_time_verified':False,
    'market_consensus_surprise_established':False,'causal_identification_established':False,
    'new_equity_labels_read':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'model_registration_required':True}
save('source_gate.json',gate)
print('E12来源通过：全16季度、17已存原公告；两直接观察渠道与E11原记录一致，0下载/股票标签/拟合。')
print('只通过两渠道及实际正文日期代理；预算/其他融资独立拆分、市场共识及历史首版未认证，E11原失败不改。')
